statement: Every control-plane system-table read carries one frozen read-authority contract (strategy, authoritative read mode, owner-RPC leader pin, local and replica-fallback consistency, routing readiness dimension, observation scope) built once at gateway ingress and threaded structurally: every coalescing identity embeds the serialized contract, executeOnPartition receives the contract instead of positional booleans, the authoritativeReadMode flags-to-enum-to-flags re-expansion and per-hop hand-enumerated option rebuilding are deleted, and no intermediate layer can drop an authority field without failing closed; all existing gateway, repository, and CDC read-path tests remain green.
